message_1_subject: Post-discovery: evaluation runbook proposal + alerting for model diffs
message_1_body:
Hi Clara / Jason,

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning — appreciated the clear summary of your use cases (customer support triage + claim summarization) and the latency/cost targets you shared. Quick recap and a practical next-step proposal so we can move to a short pilot: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce average time-to-first-helpful-response from agents by surfacing ranked suggestions and concise summaries.
- Must-haves: sub-250ms 95th percentile for single-turn generation; redaction for PII; SOC2 evidence for audit.

Redwood recommendation (pilot)- 2 variants for A/B during pilot: a higher-quality mid-size open model (quantized) for accuracy checks + a trimmed low-latency variant for latency baselines. We propose shipping an eval pack with benchmark prompts, golden responses, and a diff-monitoring runbook.

Attached: evaluation artifacts we’ll send today (zipped): clearvest-eval-pack-v1.zip — contains prompts, golden set, and an example diff sample. I’ll also share an initial mutual action plan (MAP) that maps success criteria to timeline and deliverables.

Immediate asks
1) Please confirm the list of stakeholders (I have Clara, Jason, and procurement@clearvest.com).
2) Can you confirm preferred dates for a 2-week pilot window (we prefer Apr 6–17) and procurement timelines?
3) Any must-have evaluation metrics beyond accuracy + latency (e.g., hallucination ceiling, extraction precision)?

I’ll follow up with a short runbook proposal for how we’ll surface model diffs and recommended pin/rollback thresholds.

Thanks,
Priya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

message_3_subject: Re: Post-discovery: evaluation runbook proposal + alerting for model diffs
message_3_body:
Clara — great questions. I put together a short technical runbook and proposed thresholds; attaching the eval pack + a small diff sample to make the behavior concrete. Summary below and action items at the end.

High-level detection & alerting approach
- Baseline snapshot: we’ll take a labeled golden set from your team + Redwood’s prompts. This is the baseline for automated diffing.
- Continuous sampling: during the pilot we sample 1%–5% of production requests (configurable) and run side-by-side inference on the baseline variant and the candidate variant.
- Delta detection: we compute token-level divergence, semantic similarity (embedding distance), and task-specific metric deltas (e.g., extraction F1, hallucination rate). If any metric drifts beyond configured thresholds we open an alert.

Suggested thresholds (pilot)
- Extraction F1 drop > 3 percentage points -> warning
- Hallucination rate increase > 2 percentage points -> warning
- Embedding cosine delta mean > 0.04 -> warning; >0.08 -> critical
- Any PII leakage hit -> critical and immediate disable of variant

Pin / rollback options we offer
- Snapshot pin: capture an exact model build + quant config that we can pin for your routes. Pin behaves as an explicit override at the routing layer.
- Canary rollout: we can phase traffic 10/30/60 and automatically revert to the pinned snapshot if critical alerts fire.
- Emergency freeze: operations can flip traffic to a designated fallback model (older snapshot) with sub-2min failover.

Operational notes
- We’ll surface diffs in the Console with example input/output pairs and a short diff summary. The alert includes recommended remediation (tune prompt, pin, or escalate to model team).
- For the pilot we propose a 30-day snapshot escrow window where we hold a copy of the pinned snapshot for rollback.

Attachments included (sent): clearvest-eval-pack-v1.zip, diff-sample-3.json.

Action items
1) Clara: confirm stakeholder list (please add Maya if she should be on pilot comms).
2) Clara/Procurement: confirm Apr 6–17 pilot window — if procurement needs different dates, propose alternatives.
3) Jason/AI Ops: send any additional golden examples for extraction tasks (CSV preferred).

If helpful I can schedule a short 30-min runbook walk-through with our runtime engineer (Aditya) and your AI Ops team.

Thanks,
Priya

Attachment(s): diff-sample-3.json (json, 12KB)
